name: cloudy-cgc-pub-graph-api
description: SurrealDB Hybrid Knowledge Graph - Infrastructure topology + vector search

compose._doc_post_hook: Brings the live SurrealDB root user to SURREAL_PASS. surreal only creates the root user from SURREAL_USER/SURREAL_PASS on an empty store, so a rotation (2026-10-10, after the old --pass argv leaked via docker inspect) needs DEFINE USER OVERWRITE run with the previous password. Idempotent; runs under the engine's revision-scoped post-hook receipt, so a rotation that did not apply fails the ship.

resources._comment: THE ONE DECLARATION of this container's memory budget — see user-ai_cloud-me-cgc-pvt-graph-api/build.json for the full note. src/compose.nix takes the cgroup ceiling from mem_limit and SurrealDB's RocksDB budget from rocksdb_block_cache / rocksdb_write_buffer; no literal is written in compose.nix. Measured resident set on oci-apps 2026-09-24: 131.1MiB at rest; ~945MiB peak during a full graph refresh on 2026-10-10, hence 2G.
resources._rocksdb_comment: SurrealDB RocksDB engine budget, declared on its own so the cgroup ceiling above can grow without the cache growing with it. Raised mem_limit 1G -> 2G on 2026-10-10: a full cgc graph refresh (690k-edge cloud-u-containers ingest) peaked at ~945MiB of the 1G cap and restarted both stores once mid-ingest. The cache and memtables are kept exactly where they were (512M cache, 2 x 128M memtables) so the extra GiB is pure headroom for the process, WAL and compaction. compose.nix refuses a block cache above half of mem_limit, and _shared/test-kg-store-memory-ceiling.mjs asserts mem_limit >= 2G.

node_tables._comment: octocode code-graph file nodes (full file-level mirror). One table; node_type property = file|source_file|test_file|config_file. Populated by a_solutions/user-ai_cloud-cgc-pub-mcp/src/code/octocode-export.py reading octocode's Lance graphrag_nodes per repo. key = <repo>:<path>.

edge_tables._comment: octocode code-graph relationships (file→file), e.g. sibling_module. The exporter emits whatever relationship types octocode produced; SurrealDB RELATE auto-creates any not pre-defined here.

legacy_aliases._doc: API rebrand #1450: the old names stay served for one release (DNS alias, Caddy path rewrite from _rebrand-1450/caddy-legacy-redirects.caddy, old image tag). Remove after the alias release.
